description: Change fields of a Salesforce record. Reads it first and sends If-Unmodified-Since, so it fails instead of overwriting a change made in Salesforce meanwhile; afterwards checks that Salesforce really stored every field (a trigger or validation may change values). WRITES — permission gate + write log; dry run unless the connection is live.

dry_run.description: true = build and log the request but send nothing. Writes are ALWAYS dry runs while the tenant's Salesforce connection has write_mode "dry_run" (the default).

fields.description: Field values to set (API field name → value)

id.description: ID of the Salesforce record to change

name: update_salesforce_record
